scoring_justification: All headline quantities (exact correlations, asymptotic logarithms, anisotropic correction coefficients) can be recomputed directly from the paper's closed-form expressions using mpmath and compared pointwise to the agent's values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: All gold numbers are recomputed at verify time from the paper's formulas embedded in checker.py; no external file is needed.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper equations (1), (2), (4), (5), (7), (18), (19), (20) and definitions of Bernoulli/Euler numbers, constant A, etc.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Checker runs mpmath with dps=50 to compute reference values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The formulas are taken verbatim from the published paper and are the exact same mathematics that produced the reference oracle outputs.

schema.description: Rows for 0 <= M <= N <= 5, symmetric case (sinh(2Hc)=1).

outputs.description: Exact spin correlation values C(M,N) for small distances.
Exact and asymptotic lnC(M,M) for diagonal correlation.
Exact and asymptotic lnC(M,M+1) for next-to-diagonal correlation.

schema.description: Grid of alpha and theta values from 0 to pi/2, step at least pi/16.

output_contract.notes: All formulas are deterministic and the checker recomputes the same expressions. Tolerances are set to accommodate floating-point differences across implementations.

steps.description: Exact correlation values C(M,N) for 0≤M≤N≤5; checker recomputes from paper eqs (1)-(4) and the difference equation.
Diagonal lnC(M,M) for M=1..20; checker recomputes exact (from product) and asymptotic (Bernoulli series) and compares both columns.
Next-to-diagonal lnC(M,M+1) for M=1..20; checker recomputes exact (hypergeometric) and asymptotic (Bernoulli/Euler series) and compares both columns.
Anisotropic correction coefficients A1(θ), A2(θ), A3(θ) on a grid of (α,θ); checker recomputes from eqs (18)-(20) using u=cos(2α).
